title: TransferFailed v1
description: Published to banking.transfers.failed.v1 when a recorded transfer reaches FAILED because account-service definitely rejected its posting. A posting whose outcome is unknown (timeout, connection error) does not fail the transfer and produces no event. Partition key: payload.sourceAccountId.

failureCode.description: Stable, machine-readable reason, for example INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE, ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND or CURRENCY_MISMATCH. Deliberately an open set rather than an enum, so a new reason is not a breaking change; consumers must treat unknown codes as a generic failure. There is no free-text reason, so no personal data can leak through this event.
